message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "longitudinal_classifier_comparison_for_transient_pathology", "description": "When evaluating potential transient pulmonary pathology, compare classifier confidence scores across sequential imaging timepoints to distinguish resolution from persistence.", "applicable_conditions": "Tasks involving the interpretation of serial chest imaging where the clinical question involves determining if a finding is transient (e.g., resolving edema, aspiration) or persistent (e.g., pneumonia, mass).", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["medical_imaging_interpretation"], "required_tools": ["chest_xray_classifier"], "risk_level": "medium", "core_action": "If assessing a pulmonary opacity for transient etiology: (1) call `chest_xray_classifier` on the initial image to establish baseline confidence and findings; (2) call `chest_xray_classifier` on the subsequent follow-up image; (3) compare the outputs. A transition from high-confidence opacity/strong_findings in the first scan to empty/low-confidence findings in the second confirms resolution, supporting a transient diagnosis over a persistent one."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
